footer.about: A house of quiet, considered fashion — made to be lived in.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.intro: Every token below is drawn from the MALIKA logo: the wine-burgundy of the lettering and the warm copper of its fine outline.
designSystem.colorsNote: Wine and copper are sampled directly from the logo. Cream and sage are supporting neutrals.
designSystem.typeBody: Body — clear, calm and readable at every size.

hero.title: Elegance, Reimagined.
hero.subtitle: Considered silhouettes, soft tailoring and quiet details — made for the woman who needs no introduction.

newCollection.title: A softer way to dress
newCollection.body: Warm wine, copper and cream — a palette taken from the heart of the house. Fluid fabrics, precise cuts, pieces that move with you.

editorial.title: Quiet luxury, loudly felt
editorial.body: MALIKA is built on restraint: fewer, better pieces; fabrics chosen by hand; finishing that you notice only when you wear them. This is fashion without noise.

promo.title: Complimentary delivery on your first order

shop.subtitle: Considered pieces for every day and every evening.
shop.emptyBody: Try removing a filter or browse the full collection.

product.sizeGuideNote: Measurements in centimetres, taken on the body.
product.shippingBody: Delivery within 2–5 working days across Egypt. Free delivery on your first order.
product.returnsBody: Unworn items with tags can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

collectionsPage.title: Collections
collectionsPage.intro: Each collection is a chapter: a mood, a palette, a point of view.
